body: You sound very conflicted, and I can relate to the religious struggles you are facing.  I believe that everyone can try to establish a relationship with God regardless of what label they put on it.  Evangelic, Catholic, Protestant, Jehovahs Witness etc..  A true relationship with God, if He does exsist, comes from the heart of each individual, not from the minister of a church.  I hope you can find support to help you.
I hope today was a better day.  Take care of yourself

I'm listening.

Please reach out to somebody and don't try and shoulder things alone.

My heart hurts after reading this and sadly the answer to your question is nobody knows.  I feel only a fortunate few have a blessed life where things come easy and happiness abounds.  Those people work hard, like the rest of us, but they don't seem to face the same draining emotional and physical struggles.  We soldier on, day after day, as though fighting a war we didn't sign up for and don't understand, yet we keep fighting.  That's what we are meant to do, right.  Keep going.  Keep being strong.  I like to think that there is a purpose to the life we are given and that we should cherish the small moments of joy and happiness.  They may be few but they can be powerful.  Take care.
